name: Pharmacy Counter
summary: Unbranded pharmacy service counter with a glazed pass-through, open dispensing rack, blank overhead sign, queue display and pickup tray.
description: Original compact floor-standing pharmacy station for stores S04, S05 and S12. The rear-edge dispensing rack is open on both sides and stays within the counter footprint; the staff working aisle is outside the asset. The queue screen has static original seven-segment numerals only.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python; no external models, images, textures, fonts, packaging or brands. Static queue numerals are original seven-segment mesh geometry.

display.origin: Floor centre of the complete counter footprint

accuracy_notes: Static illustrative asset; queue digits do not change, glazing does not move and there is no dispensing or medical logic. Rear-edge rack, no enclosed medicine cabinet or independent sliding window. Staff aisle, medical/storage, hygiene, structural, accessibility and safety compliance are unverified. Three material primitives do not establish complete-mall draw-call performance. Physical Android/iOS and WebKit NOT TESTED.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and three shared materials. No external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
